verdict.rationale: Databricks documents Genie Code as an in-workspace AI assistant you chat with. It generates and runs code, builds pipelines and AI/BI dashboards, debugs errors, and runs as an autonomous agent that plans and asks for approval before using tools. Genie separately lets users ask data questions in natural language. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation, and evidence that platform administration (e.g., compute or permissions) can be driven by natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Chat with Genie Code, get inline suggestions, and run agentic tasks in your workspace.
Run Genie Code as an autonomous agent that plans, runs code, fixes errors, and asks for approval before it uses tools.
It generates and runs code, builds pipelines and AI/BI dashboards, debugs errors, and works directly with Unity Catalog tables, columns, and lineage to accelerate multi-step data work.
Ask data questions in natural language and get answers grounded in your organization's data.
From natural language dashboard creation to deep conversational analytics with Genie, this is BI built on AI from the start.
